title: Foundations Capstone
introduction: A small completed program demonstrates algorithms, data, control flow, functions, validation and debugging together.
learningOutcomes: Review a project against foundational skills.

activities.question: Which project scope is best for a first capstone?
options: A small complete tool with clear acceptance checks
A global social network built in one sitting
A project with no way to test it
activities.explanation: A deliberately small complete project provides practice across the whole development cycle.

activities.question: A capstone is complete only when it includes every imaginable feature.
activities.explanation: Completion means meeting the defined scope and acceptance criteria, not endless expansion.

activities.question: Order a sensible capstone workflow.

items.text: Test normal, boundary and invalid cases

activities.explanation: Define success first, build incrementally, test thoroughly and then reflect.
